title: pvTemporalStatistics
body:
## pvTemporalStatistics

Computes, for every point and cell array of a time-dependent input, its average, minimum, maximum and population standard deviation over all input time steps, which the filter requests itself. The output has the input's type and geometry, no time, and arrays named <name>_average, <name>_minimum, <name>_maximum and <name>_stddev (other arrays are not kept). Every step is weighted equally regardless of time spacing, so this is not a time integral. This is the generated binding with native names (ComputeAverage, …); the curated temporalStatistics does the same with shorter option names.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Unequal time steps bias the average; resample time first if the spacing varies.
- Every time step is read and processed, which can take long on large series; restrict the input time range first.
- The mesh must keep the same points and cells over time; on changing meshes the statistics are meaningless.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TemporalStatistics`. Identity: `filters/TemporalStatistics`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the Temporal Statistics filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ComputeAverage` | Compute the average of each point and cell variable over time. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeMaximum` | Compute the maximum of each point and cell variable over time. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeMinimum` | Compute the minimum of each point and cell variable over time. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeStandardDeviation` | Compute the standard deviation of each point and cell variable over time. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTemporalStatistics",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
